resources.string: Optional Instagram-only structural diagnostic; Instagram is not protected. Fresh consent in Doom allows at most 128 nodes through depth 8. One hidden report in process memory contains only sanitized static Instagram resource names from compile-time resource tables, normalized safe classes, depth, child count capped at 16 and clickable/scrollable/editable/selected/checked booleans, aggregated and sorted. Previously unknown resource names are admitted only as exact com.instagram.android:id/ names: 1–64 lowercase ASCII letters/digits/underscores, starting with a letter, at most 96 raw characters. Invalid IDs and unknown classes are omitted. Maximum 64 unique tokens and 8,192 ASCII characters/UTF-8 bytes; truncation is marked. Reports expose static resource names, never UI text/content/account values. No text, descriptions, hints, errors, titles, bounds, screenshots, notification/account content, node/window IDs, raw trees or actions. Only consent is saved. No report files, logs, network or automatic export. Explicit local reveal and reviewed clipboard copy are available in Doom. Copy leaves Doom memory: review before copying, upload privately, then clear the clipboard. Clear, revocation, observer stop/disconnect/interruption/reconnect and process death remove the report and reveal/copy state, but cannot recall external copies. No screen identification, prediction, blocking or navigation. Turn off at any time.
